notes.title: Meet the Scarab King
notes.content:
[h1]The Curse of the Scarab King - Free Expansion[/h1]
A free expansion brings 5 new levels and a challenge where you face the Scarab King himself! As well as mummies to mash in place of tourists, there are switch controlled bridges (don't dump your friends in the drink) and deadly traps you can temporarily disable with a gem torn from a scarab's carapace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/ed74eaddc7e7f1777a00a9e42593b5d0868bb456.png[/img]

But that’s not all! Eight new hats and weapons give you even more options for picking a unique look, so you can cook and chop in style!

[h2]20% discount as we welcome new chefs![/h2]
Now Xbox and Playstation fans can try their hand at Cannibal Cuisine as it's out now on Xbox and PlayStation, plus the Microsoft Store on PC! The game naturally includes the free Curse of the Scarab King expansion, and comes with a 20% launch discount which we’re bringing to Steam as well! So if you’ve been waiting for your chance to try your hand as a chef, now’s the perfect time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/eb6045b046ad434bb2e7b4d16559a23f270dfb51.png[/img]

[h2]That’s all for now: let’s get cooking![/h2]

notes.title: Have you tried competitive cooking?
notes.content:
Most of you have probably noticed the Versus mode option in the main menu, but have you tried it out? You might be surprised!

[h2]Competitive mode?[/h2]
The goal of competitive mode is the same as the campaign - cook the right dishes to feed your Hoochooboo. The challenge comes from the other team who are trying to feed their Hoochooboo faster... and the fact that tourists are a shared resource!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/ebaed6e21219d303c0205f87026f9b23575fc2de.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/ebaed6e21219d303c0205f87026f9b23575fc2de.png[/img][/url]

As you can see in the image above, the tourists appear in a central area accessible to both teams. This can lead to some manic melees as you end up fighting tourists and the other team at the same time! Or just run in after the other team has been fighting and swipe their hard earned meat. [i]We're talking about 'teams' here, but you can definitely play competitive mode in 1v1![/i]


The cooking areas are protected - mostly - so the other team can't just run in and spoil your meals, but almost everywhere else is fair game. The goal is simple, but the best way to win is more complex. Focus too much on blocking the other team and you'll not feed your own Hoochooboo enough, but it's not wise to just let them get on with it either.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/2f6f3fd43d6f985a759762b8fe8ef6d2c4c13d6b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/2f6f3fd43d6f985a759762b8fe8ef6d2c4c13d6b.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]This screenshot by player Katastrophy suggests that feeding your god is a better way to win than dying ;)[/i]


If you have played Versus mode, let us know what you thought [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1136020/discussions/]on the Steam Hub[/url]! Or share your most fiendish strategies for fouling up the other team...

notes.title: Update: movement system and controls improved!
notes.content:
We’re over the moon to see you all play our game!!! The launch has been delicious and now it’s time to make the game even tastier!  

This past week we have noticed some feedback on the controls, movement and difficulty of the game. We straight away started to process your feedback which resulted in today’s update!

Expect an all new improved movement system and controls, and that’s not all!
Here is the full list:[list]
[*] Adjusted controller thumbstick deadzone and sensitivity 
[*] Slowed overall player running speed 
[*] Adjusted how players react with ledges making it easier to recover when running off one 
[*] Made floating barrels travel slower in the jungle levels 
[*] Increased the amount of time a dish cook before it is no longer considered perfect 
[*] Added mouse support for menu navigation
[*] Renamed Banana slap to Banana Grabber
[*] Fixed an issue with Dash causing players to slide on walls or edges 
[*] Fixed various bugs with scene transitions 
[*] Fixed an issue preventing some non-player characters from spawning in online games 
[*] Fixed an issue where the tourist boss was invisible to other clients
[*] Fixed various connectivity issues[/list]

Thank you for your continued support!

To close off with, this weeks highlights are GameByte with a great summary of Cannibal Cuisine on [url=https://www.facebook.com/GameByte/videos/576890799600546/]Facebook [/url] and also a video of by YouTube channel Stumpt. Fun fact: they inspired us to change one of our recipes names to Banana Grabber.
https://youtu.be/2vIoi4ChAY0

- The Rocket Vulture Team –

notes.title: Time to cook 'em up! Cannibal Cuisine is out now...
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pPmrSPS7lK8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Light the BBQ, and let's get cooking![/h2]
Cannibal Cuisine is out now here (and on Nintendo Switch), and we have a [b]25% launch discount[/b] active to celebrate!! Play through the 24 stage story campaign with 1-4 chefs, or fight boisterous cooking battles in versus mode, where you can win by outcooking the opposition, or simply stomp them into the ground!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/5d3fd47c65c5d9cc5477125cd9f5fee7c9a36e4c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/5d3fd47c65c5d9cc5477125cd9f5fee7c9a36e4c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Hoochooboo has awakened, and he's hungry![/h2]
Unfortunately for you, he only eats human meat - with perhaps a little fruit or vegetables for taste. Test your cooking talents through locations ranging from jungles and temples to beaches and volcanoes as you try to figure out a way to defeat the cannibal god Hoochooboo once and for all! You'll have to master an increasing range of recipes at the same time as facing ever more dangerous 'kitchens'. If that wasn't enough, every area ends with a 'boss battle' posing a unique challenge that might not even be cooking related!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/292bf2a9b9fea45386d41d0f99f68e69fcd83ae6.png[/img]
Got questions? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1136020/discussions/0/2865909716041898831/]Check out the FAQ[/url], or hop on our [url=https://discord.gg/tK5ykS]Discord[/url].

Sounds good? A deadly tropical paradise and Hoochooboo's dark hunger await!


Team Rocket Vulture

notes.title: Calling all chefs to the jungle for May 20th!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Ag_5o-vgvWg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Set your oven timers for May 20th... Cannibal Cuisine officially has a release date![/h2]
When your man-eating god Hoochooboo awakes from a dark slumber, you'd better feed them fast! Fight tourists to turn them into ingredients, put the right recipes together on your skewers, and make the most of your voodoo powers to go for three stars on every level. 

Play the 24 level story campaign with up to 4 chefs, or engage in competitive versus mode cooking contests, playable both locally and online. As the chaos ramps up you'll need to dodge lava, board boats and avoid spikes while feeding ever more picky incarnations of Hoochooboo. And that doesn't even include the 'boss' maps at the end of each area, which will test more than just your cooking capabilities...

You can wishlist the game to get a notification on launch to make sure you don't miss out on the [b]25% release celebration discount![/b]

[h3]Looking for a starter course? Try the open beta on Steam.[/h3]
Something else you can find on the store page is the [b]open beta download link![/b] Hit the demo button to grab the open beta and try out four levels. We'd love to hear your feedback [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1136020/discussions/]on our Steam hub![/url]

[i]The open beta won't stay open forever, so if you're interested move fast![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/972146500040f1d67c1e2d7dd694dee5aa02c597.gif[/img]

Still have questions? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1136020/discussions/0/2865909716041898831/]Check out the FAQ[/url], or hop on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/XEagpXt]Discord![/url]

[b]Now get ready and sharpen your knives! Hoochooboo is almost awake...[/b]

notes.title: April News!
notes.content:
[h2]Full steam ahead![/h2]
Development is going well. We've been polishing the gameplay and finalizing the design of all the levels - [b]20 of them, plus 4 boss challenges[/b]! On top of that, we've also got [b]new cover art[/b]. Check it out!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/5994f811482e11c72ff30e8afe42f9020b81c816.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/5994f811482e11c72ff30e8afe42f9020b81c816.png[/img][/url]

Yesterday we introduced the Cannibal Cuisine Cooking Gadget. For those of you who cook meat in real life, the idea was that you'd be able to prove it and gain more powered up abilities and points for your dishes in the game! Before anyone gets too excited, double check the date...

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/203a795ea81b65fa0008799353b101c89138d1ff.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/203a795ea81b65fa0008799353b101c89138d1ff.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming soon - dev chats![/h2]
The team kindly took a few moments out of their busy schedules to answer a few questions about themselves and the development of Cannibal Cuisine. Expect some interesting Q&A, development trivia, and cool concept art. As a teaser, here's developer Niels -aka Jonesah- talks about his favorite and most inspirational games:

[b]Jonesah:[/b] [i]One of the games that triggers me most has always been Molyneux’s Black & White. Something about the ability to shape a world is very inspiring. Other than that I’m a sucker for immersive experiences. A truly fleshed out world with believable characters draws me in and makes me dream. The later Wing Commander games or the Mass Effect trilogy are good examples of this.[/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/d2ec1a5e2574e6807c2df101e47441fde788a120.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958689/d2ec1a5e2574e6807c2df101e47441fde788a120.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Release is drawing closer, so watch this space for more news and updates![/b]

notes.title: Cannibal Cuisine set for Q1 2020!
notes.content:
The jungle is in an uproar for this action packed cooking game, as the Gods are hungry... for you! Though as all good cannibal cooks know, serving is better than being served. Luckily the ingredients these man-munching gods demand are readily available in the jungle, such as unwary selfie shooting tourists!

Developing a taste for cooking by games such as Overcooked, inspired us to create our own unique cuisine, a cannibalistic one. A spicy homage to Overcooked can be seen in the trailer to show their gratitude.

Check out the meaty trailer: https://youtu.be/DVhulrOyzlI

[h2]Ingredients revealed[/h2]
[b]Free range organic food… mostly[/b]
The recipes for success are varied; find delicious fruits and vegetables, and combine them with freshly chopped and cooked tourists for a truly divine delicacy fit for the God Hoochooboo. Of course the tourists might not offer themselves up freely, the heathens, so you’ll need to master your arcade reflexes, voodoo magic and fire breathing, useful for baking as well, to persuade them without getting KO’d!

[b]Claim your Michelin stars with 1 to 4 players[/b]
Ready, steady, cook your way through a full campaign alone or with up to 4 chefs or challenge each other to cooking battles in PvP. With so many chefs in the kitchen, chaos is sure to follow. Outsmart rival cannibals while chasing tourists or work together as a crew to serve up the most epic of mealtimes to your god.

Sharpen your knives for the next year release, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1136020/Cannibal_Cuisine]wishlist[/url] the game now!

Bon appetit,
Rocket Vulture
